apps.name: Apollo
apps.subtitle: Apollo for Reddit with ApolloReborn
apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project's ongoing fixes and enhancements.

This source mirrors the GLASS Icons variant, which bundles the Liquid Glass alternate icon catalog without the iOS 26 UI runtime opt-in, so legacy UIKit behaviors such as the bottom tab bar swipe gesture are preserved.

This source is intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take photos to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to save media or to select images to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Detect rotations in Media Viewer and offer corresponding options.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Checked once to calculate sunset/sunrise times for the location.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock Apollo when re-opening in order to prevent unauthorized access.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/releases/tag/v1.15.11_4.0.1
Upstream asset: "Apollo-Reborn-4.0.1-GLASS.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Performance

- Send fewer Reddit requests on API-Key-Free accounts by not repeating link preview lookups for sites that block previews and by briefly reusing the Inbox's reply lookups, so ordinary reading reaches Reddit's rate limit later (#1579: @icpryde)
  - New replies, and anything you post or edit, still refresh right away

Fixes

- Fix multi-photo posts showing a reddit.com link and 0 photos since Reddit began marking their photos as failed, so the gallery, feed carousel, media viewer, Save All and Gallery View show them again (#1589: @icpryde)
  - Covers galleries posted from Apollo with Reddit as the Media Upload Host and from other apps; they show as square cards in the feed
- Fix API-Key-Free search showing "Error searching" or "Error loading subreddits" for post search, searching within a subreddit or multireddit, and subreddit search (#1557: @DeltAndy123)
- Fix All Posts (r/all) showing "Couldn't load posts" on API-Key-Free accounts, for every sort and with Exclude Subscriptions (#1570: @icpryde)
  - All Posts has another way in before Old Reddit, and if Reddit blocks another API-Key-Free read, a route update can work around it without an app update (#1594: @DeltAndy123)
- Open the feed you chose to start on again at launch by turning Restore Reading Session off by default; it moves to Posts & Feeds → Feed (#1511: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - A choice you changed yourself in 4.0.0 is kept, so turn it back on there if you relied on the 4.0.0 default
- Fix a crash when opening a post or comment link while Reddit is rate-limiting requests, most often right after returning to Apollo; the usual "Error loading comments" banner shows instead (#1572: @icpryde)
- Fix the home screen icon turning into iOS's generic grid after installing or updating Apollo with an alternate icon selected (#1554: @icpryde)
  - Apollo re-applies your icon once on the first launch after the update, so iOS shows its "You have changed the icon" alert; tapping the selected icon again under App Icon also redraws it
- Open a tapped Inbox reply or comment link directly on that comment, without the post flashing, gliding and snapping into place, and keep your place when returning from a pushed page (#1584: @icpryde)
- Show the Unrecoverable label on deleted comments the archive can't restore, instead of a thin, cut-off red strip with only the age showing (#1578: @icpryde)
- Load Live Interactive Posts for accounts set to old Reddit, instead of spinning on "Loading interactive post…", and make the ✕ and ••• buttons work in an interactive post's expanded view (#1553: @icpryde)
  - Report from the ••• menu opens and closes properly, and feed cards return to their compact size after closing
- Keep sign-in, Badge Book trophies and API-Key-Free backup reads working for accounts Old Reddit turns away (#1553: @icpryde)
  - The API-Key-Free sign-in sheet no longer offers Switch to Old Reddit
- Open a just-posted video post with its video playing from the "Posted! Tap to view." banner, instead of a still image (#1413: @icpryde)
  - The banner now waits until Reddit finishes processing the video, so it can appear a few seconds later; applies to videos uploaded with Media Upload Host set to Reddit
- Stop the media post composer jumping when you pick a flair or photo with a title that wraps onto two or more lines (#1571: @icpryde)
- Open the subreddit switcher with the keyboard down, so your favorites stay visible until you tap the search field (#1564: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Stop the rows Apollo Reborn adds to the classic (non-Liquid Glass) post ••• menu turning green on subreddits you moderate; they follow your theme again, and Remove from Recently Read is red (#1566: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Bring back the Search tab's search bar and tab bar on a downward flick after Hide Bars on Scroll hid them on the classic (non-Liquid Glass) look, instead of leaving them hidden until Apollo restarts (#1575: @icpryde)
- Stop quick Posts tab taps on Liquid Glass opening a post or username behind the tab bar while going back a page; repeated taps keep stepping back right away (#1512: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Let a swipe over Community Highlights go Back once the carousel is at its first highlight, and Forward at its last when there is a page to go forward to, instead of only bouncing (#1577: @icpryde, @nnastasi)
- Make Open in Apollo (Manual Fallback) open Apollo directly when Link Companion isn't installed, instead of reloading the page and hiding its button (#1574: @icpryde)
  - iOS asks before switching to Apollo; the fix comes with the IPAs that include the Safari extensions
- Polish the unfolded iPhone Duo split view: Gallery View uses the whole screen instead of sitting partly behind the feed column or sidebar, and the YouTube loading screen covers the whole split instead of one column (#1496, #1516: @nnastasi)
  - The comment jump button stays inside the comments pane for every Jump Button Position, and off the fold when partially folded (#1490: @nnastasi)
- Fix iPad Layout (Beta) crashing Apollo Reborn settings when Liquid Glass is off, and fix the Subreddits list, feed rows, pane titles, selection outlines and sign-in notice being squeezed, clipped or hidden under the sidebar (#1504: @DeltAndy123)
  - iPad Layout now needs iPadOS 26 or later with Liquid Glass on; message threads always show their reply bar, and the Account tab's Saved, Hidden & Deleted, Recently Read and Friends rows highlight and take keyboard focus one at a time

Upstream release: https://github.com/Apollo-Reborn/Apollo-Reborn/releases/tag/v1.15.11_4.0.0
Upstream asset: "Apollo-Reborn-4.0.0-GLASS.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Features

- Add iPhone Duo support with layouts that adapt to the closed display, open portrait, open landscape and partially folded positions, using the existing Apollo Reborn builds (#1245: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Browse a feed beside its comments, choose Original or Focused content widths, and open the subreddit list in a Standard or Liquid Glass panel
  - Inbox, Account and Settings gain sidebar/detail layouts in open landscape, while Search can keep results beside the page you open
  - Pixel Pals is unavailable on Duo; regular iPhones keep it
- Add an optional iPad Layout (Beta) on iPadOS 18 and later, with a native sidebar, adjustable feed and reader columns, and full-width Gallery View (#1385: @jordanearle)
  - Try it from the one-time invitation or turn on iPad Layout under Interface; quit and reopen Apollo to apply it, or turn it off to return to the classic layout
- Add Restore Reading Session to reopen your last feed, post and nearby reading position after iOS closes Apollo, including feed and comment sorting (#1441: @Thetromboneman1)
  - On by default under Media → Browsing; explicit links and notifications take priority, and turning it off deletes the saved session
- Add a Setup Assistant for new installations to connect or restore, choose Classic, Balanced or Full Featured preferences, select appearance, and review before applying (#1401: @jordanearle)
  - Existing users can open it from Apollo Reborn settings with Keep My Settings selected; updating does not automatically apply a preset
- Rework Gallery View with faster opening, pinch-to-resize tiles including a denser four-column layout, and native press-and-hold menus in the grid and fullscreen viewer (#1389, #1434: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Sports clips can play silently in the grid, newly visible tiles start reliably, and returning from a fullscreen image no longer leaves a black screen
- Open Gallery View for All Saved or a selected Saved category, with empty categories shown without an endless spinner (#1440: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Rebuild Recently Read as a native Apollo feed that follows your post layout, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus (#1442: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Open it from its own row on your profile, switch its layout without changing other feeds, clear the history, or remove individual posts
- Add Recently Visited subreddits to Search, with configurable section order and limits under Subreddits settings (#1404: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - History clears on restart or account change and is not saved to backups
- Add Add Downvote Tap under Posts & Feeds → Info Row so tapping a score can cycle through upvote, downvote and no vote; off by default (#1403: @AcornElf)
- Add a Subreddit Icon switch to Compact and Immersive subreddit header layouts, updating the preview and live header together (#1426: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Feature seasonal icons in Daily Spotlight around holidays, including Apollo's original holiday icons; the spotlight now shows six picks (#1390, #1245: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Tint Apollo Reborn maintainer usernames purple in posts, comments and the Inbox, while retaining their real profiles and normal moderator indicators (#1411: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Make Bug Reports attach a removable debug log automatically, and mask usernames, account details, links and sensitive values before logs are exported or shared (#1422, #1423: @icpryde)
  - Export Debug Logs now shares a file that can be attached on GitHub; subreddit names, post/comment IDs and diagnostic details remain readable

Performance

- Reduce unnecessary API-Key-Free requests by fetching subscriptions in larger pages and, with Reduce Rate Limiting on, batching feed avatars by page; interrupted subscription refreshes keep the existing list (#1416: @icpryde)
  - Deleted or unavailable Bluesky previews stop repeatedly fetching themselves and using Reddit requests as a fallback

Fixes

- Refine Duo navigation with steadier feed positions and search bars when columns change, a smoother subreddit drawer, correct Home/Popular/All restoration, and Reddit links opened from Settings routed to Posts (#1470: @nnastasi)
  - Resume videos that were playing before folding or unfolding, covering both shared Reddit videos and direct-player media
- Center folded Duo title pills in the usable header and keep composer text clear of the right-hand system strip, with correct wrapping and height through folding and unfolding (#1480: @jordanearle)
- Keep the same Duo comments thread when returning from a linked subreddit after rotation or folding, and let the drawer return to an older retained feed correctly (#1464: @jordanearle)
- Correct Duo video autoplay around the side rail and both columns' navigation bars (#1466: @kiliantyler)
- Keep View All Comments visible inside its Duo comments pane when opening a specific comment (#1468: @d0lb33)
- Stop the hidden subreddit index swallowing favorite taps and scrolling near the stars on Duo (#1469: @kiliantyler)
- Open native action menus from controls moved into UIKit's overflow menu instead of silently dismissing without showing the actions (#1474: @kiliantyler)
- Keep loading API-Key-Free Inbox rows when looking up a reply's quoted parent fails, showing the messages without that quote (#1455: @icpryde, @DeltAndy123)
- Keep API-Key-Free infinite scrolling retryable after Reddit returns a rate limit or block page, rather than treating the refusal as the end of the feed (#1424: @icpryde)
- Load the next feed page when Hide Read hides every loaded post, including with Infinite Scrolling off (#1412: @icpryde)
- Fix Reddit image uploads becoming broken links when Imgur is selected, single-photo comment uploads failing, and synthetic album links in comments (#1402, #1406: @jordanearle, @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Previously broken uploads still need to be uploaded again
- Give inline comment images and GIFs Copy Image, Save Image and Share actions, and open loaded images fullscreen without a second loading fade (#1400: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Show the correct image, GIF, video and album menus when pressing and holding media inside a post, including Save All Media for albums (#1435: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix a crash when opening a compact album from its long-press preview (#1398: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix crashes while feed videos wait to play and while deleted comments are being prepared (#1428, #1450: @Thetromboneman1)
- Keep a playing feed video's sound and mute icon in step when opening its post, including with the phone's silent switch on (#1425: @icpryde)
- Stop rich link cards shifting the feed or changing their image crop after voting (#1457: @icpryde)
- Open Find in Comments from the Liquid Glass post menu with its search field, keyboard and result navigation working correctly (#1446: @icpryde)
- Keep a collapsed feed search bar hidden when returning from the fullscreen image viewer (#1447: @Thetromboneman1)
- Bring back the complete Liquid Glass tab bar after swiping back from Edit Profile, including its glass background (#1431: @icpryde)
- Refresh subreddit icons and banners from current Reddit artwork instead of retaining older images (#1396: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Preserve usernames in comment and post headers by shortening flair first, while keeping timestamps and other trailing details visible (#1366: @AcornElf)
- Open Reddit social links on profiles directly in Apollo instead of the browser (#1407: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Explain why Notifications settings are unavailable when no notification backend is configured, instead of spinning forever (#1399: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Open Poll, Media, Link and Text post shortcuts in the correct editor even when the composer finishes preparing after its sheet appears (#1414: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Keep the separator below Home's first post visible after switching tabs and refreshing (#1405: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Stop the Boxes title truncating after returning from an inbox on Liquid Glass (#1395: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Apply a custom theme's bar color behind classic feed and comment search bars with Pure Black Dark Mode off (#1459: @icpryde)
- Match the Portrait Lock settings page to the inset, rounded style of other settings screens (#1410: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Check for updates every 15 minutes while Apollo is active, and remember Later for the same version for 24 hours across restarts (#1436: @IllIIllIllIllII)

Known issues

- Reddit currently blocks the API-Key-Free route used for Load More Comments and some post/subreddit lookups; the Inbox failure fallback above does not repair that route.

apps.name: Plezy
apps.subtitle: A Plex and Jellyfin client
apps.localizedDescription: A modern cross-platform Plex and Jellyfin client.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/edde746/plezy/releases/tag/2.25.0
Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
New features

- Skip Intro and Skip Credits recognise chapters with generic or non-English names
- Add to… playlists and collections on Jellyfin and Emby
- Scan Library Files on Jellyfin and Emby
- New airings show a NEW badge in the Live TV guide
- Explore can be the Startup Section
- The Performance Overlay shows Direct Play or Transcoding

plezy:// links

- Links can open Plezy in a chosen profile
- Links play a movie or show by TMDB, TVDB, IMDb or Plex ID from any server
- A show link plays the next episode, or shuffles the show
- Show link on movies, shows, episodes and profiles gives the link and a QR code
- Live TV links work on Apple TV
- A link wakes Google TV from the screensaver
- Outplayer, Infuse and VLC on iOS return to Plezy with where playback stopped

Watch Together

- Opening an ended room from Recent Rooms starts it again under the same code
- A host playing a download shares it while its server is online
- Guests play their own download of the room's file instead of streaming it
- Videos played from Downloads join the room

Playback

- Normalize Loudness no longer silences 5.1 audio on some devices on Android MPV
- Resuming no longer skips up to half a second of audio on Android MPV
- Passthrough no longer stops playback after a display mode switch on Android MPV
- Subtitle lines near the start of a video no longer go missing
- Audio Passthrough stays on after a Dolby track fails to pass through on Apple devices
- Plex shows play in season order even when episode air dates are wrong
- Back on the Play Next prompt leaves the player
- Audio Sync moves in 10 ms steps
- The volume slider shows the level while dragging

UI

- Posters in dense grids are no longer cropped at the top and bottom
- Profiles no longer show the Plex account name when only one account is signed in
- Watch Together, themes, Supporter and newer settings are translated in every language
- Explore posters load for Plex users with Seerr's Enable Image Caching on
- Cancel on a download notification stops the download instead of restarting it
- Continue Watching fits on the first screen of Home on compact phones
- Screens and sheets stay clear of the status column on iPhone Duo
- The Home profile avatar opens the profile menu instead of Control Center on iPhone Duo

TV

- The remote keeps working after switching profiles
- Backing out of a finished episode focuses the next episode in Continue Watching
- The Apple TV Top Shelf shows series posters unless Episode Poster Style is Season Poster

Desktop

- Skipping or closing a video no longer freezes the screen on macOS 27
- Blacks are no longer washed out with HDR on in Windows

Upstream release: https://github.com/edde746/plezy/releases/tag/2.24.0
Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
New features

- Detail pages show scores from connected Trakt, Simkl, MyAnimeList, AniList and MDBList accounts
- Person pages show the biography, birth and death dates, and birthplace
- Deinterlacing has a Film mode for telecined DVDs on MPV
- Dolby Vision plays on macOS

Supporter

- A one-time Supporter purchase on the App Store and Google Play unlocks themes and app icons
- Five colour themes: Ember, Glacier, Forest, Plum and Paper
- Custom themes with your own colours
- 23 alternate app icons on iOS, tvOS and Android
- Free in the Microsoft Store, Amazon Appstore, macOS and Linux versions
- Not offered in the GitHub Android, iOS and Windows builds

Watch Together

- Rooms run on Open Watch Party and work with other Open Watch Party apps
- Rooms work across servers: each person plays their own copy from their Plex, Jellyfin or Emby servers
- Room codes have six characters
- Rooms use public relays by default
- A custom relay must be an Open Watch Party relay
- Everyone in a room needs this version of Plezy or another Open Watch Party app

Performance

- Fewer dropped frames scrolling Home rows and library grids with the D-pad on TV boxes
- Fewer dropped frames opening detail pages on TV boxes
- Fewer dropped frames opening the player on TV boxes
- Seek-bar previews load with about a third of the peak memory

Playback

- Subtitle lines no longer go missing after seeking or switching tracks
- Normalize Loudness no longer stutters video on Android MPV
- Normalize Loudness keeps 5.1 audio in 5.1 on Android MPV
- 24 fps video on a 60 Hz display no longer judders every few seconds on Android MPV
- 24 fps video no longer stutters on MediaTek TVs and projectors with motion processing on Android MPV
- The next episode keeps HDR10 and Dolby Vision on Sony Bravia TVs with Android MPV
- Dolby Vision profile 5 no longer plays magenta and green on iPad (10th and 11th generation)
- Plex and Emby playback no longer crashes seconds in on 32-bit Android TV boxes
- Skip Credits no longer appears in the middle of a movie
- Previous restarts a movie
- The audio output picked in the player is remembered across videos
- Remember Player Changes set to Per library or Per show no longer carries changes into other libraries
- Starting Picture-in-Picture no longer crashes on iPhone and iPad
- Subtitles keep their size after locking an iPhone or iPad while the video is zoomed
- A failed screenshot shows an error

Apple audio

- 5.1 and 7.1 audio plays as multichannel instead of stereo on iPhone and iPad
- Audio Passthrough on iPhone, iPad and Mac, for Dolby Atmos on AirPods and Mac speakers
- With Audio Passthrough on, TrueHD Atmos and DTS:X play as spatial audio on iOS and tvOS 26
- Audio Passthrough applies to music
- The player settings show Spatial Audio or Dolby Atmos rendering on iPhone and iPad
- Changing playback speed no longer freezes video on Apple devices
- Audio no longer skips on AirPods on macOS 27

Live TV

- Live TV buffers ~6 s before playing instead of stalling every few seconds
- MPEG-2 channels no longer show a blank or stalling picture on Android MPV
- The player's Go to Live control has a label
- Program descriptions show on Jellyfin and Emby

Plex

- Posters and backdrops no longer fail to load in batches on Android
- A server that comes back on a new address reconnects without restarting Plezy
- Reconnect shows an error when nothing connects

Jellyfin & Emby

- Seek-bar previews show again
- Home rows follow the library order set in Manage Libraries
- The Choose audio by language toggle is no longer inverted
- Seasons without their own backdrop show the series backdrop
- Emby search on large libraries returns people and movies instead of timing out
- The Apple TV Top Shelf shows Continue Watching from Jellyfin 12 servers

Explore & trackers

- Tracker scores on Explore items show which service they come from
- Seerr artwork loads when Seerr's Enable Image Caching is on

Downloads

- Large downloads to a custom folder on Android finish instead of restarting from 0%
- Pausing a download to a custom folder on Android resumes where it stopped
- A download to a custom folder continues after Android closes Plezy instead of making a numbered copy
- Numbered copies left in a custom folder by earlier versions are removed

UI

- Hero backdrops are sharp on portrait phones
- The home hero carousel crossfades artwork between slides
- Built-in labels such as Copy and Paste follow the app language
- Rotating an Android phone no longer leaves the UI squeezed into part of the screen
- Library grids no longer lose cards when a page reloads
- Leaving the MPV config editor with the back arrow keeps the latest edits
- The Android launcher icon is centred

TV

- Smaller wide cards and more space between rows on Home, Explore and library screens
- Smaller hero title
- Each grid density step gives a different card size
- Grids default to normal spacing
- The remote keeps working after closing Profiles or the PIN prompt opened from the avatar menu
- Quick gamepad Back presses on a detail page no longer close the screen beneath it

Desktop

- Shaders and ambient lighting are no longer available on macOS
- Chinese text no longer uses Japanese character forms on Windows
- Linux shows Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese text in their own character forms

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This app uses the local network to control to media servers and players.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to scan QR codes for Companion Remote pairing.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app needs to connect to your media servers on your local network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Plezy uses location access when iOS requires it to detect your local network and connect to your media servers.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Plezy needs photo library access so you can choose images to upload as media artwork.
privacy.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Allow notifications from friends, recommendations, your media server and more.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your data will be used to deliver the most relevant ads when watching free movies and shows.

- Guests play their own download of the room's file instead of streaming it
- Videos played from Downloads join the room

- Normalize Loudness no longer silences 5.1 audio on some devices on Android MPV
- Resuming no longer skips up to half a second of audio on Android MPV
- Passthrough no longer stops playback after a display mode switch on Android MPV
- Subtitle lines near the start of a video no longer go missing
- Audio Passthrough stays on after a Dolby track fails to pass through on Apple devices
- Plex shows play in season order even when episode air dates are wrong
- Back on the Play Next prompt leaves the player
- Audio Sync moves in 10 ms steps
- The volume slider shows the level while dragging

UI

- Posters in dense grids are no longer cropped at the top and bottom
- Profiles no longer show the Plex account name when only one account is signed in
- Watch Together, themes, Supporter and newer settings are translated in every language
- Explore posters load for Plex users with Seerr's Enable Image Caching on
- Cancel on a download notification stops the download instead of restarting it
- Continue Watching fits on the first screen of Home on compact phones
- Screens and sheets stay clear of the status column on iPhone Duo
- The Home profile avatar opens the profile menu instead of Control Center on iPhone Duo

TV

- The remote keeps working after switching profiles
- Backing out of a finished episode focuses the next episode in Continue Watching
- The Apple TV Top Shelf shows series posters unless Episode Poster Style is Season Poster

Desktop

- Skipping or closing a video no longer freezes the screen on macOS 27
- Blacks are no longer washed out with HDR on in Windows

apps.name: Twitch
apps.subtitle: Twitch with TwitchAdBlock
apps.localizedDescription:
Twitch with the unofficial TwitchAdBlock tweak for sideloading.

It blocks live-stream and VOD ads, removes feed promotions and ad-network requests, supports authenticated and fallback proxies, renders 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, and adds app customization options.

This source mirrors the patched Twitch IPA published by gunnerkidBT's TwitchAdBlock fork. The fork maintains compatibility with newer Twitch and iOS versions and is not affiliated with Twitch Interactive.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/releases/tag/v31.7-0.1.15
Upstream asset: "tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.15.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
TwitchMods v0.1.15, for Twitch iOS 31.7

New: see what moderators delete
Turn on Keep Deleted Messages in Settings → Emotes. When a moderator deletes a message, or times out or bans someone, their messages stay in chat instead of disappearing, and a short note like "🛡 ronni was timed out for 10m" shows up so you know what happened.
- Want the notes to stand out? Turn on Highlight Notes, right under it, to give them a highlighted background.
- Both are off by default. It only works for things that happen while you're in chat.

New: hide the "From channels you follow" bar
Turn on Hide "From Channels You Follow" in Settings → Home to remove the row of clips and recaps above the live channels on the Live page.

Fixed
- The "Go Ad-Free" button on the Following tab is hidden again. Twitch 31.7 rebuilt that tab, so the old way of hiding it stopped working.

Everything from v0.1.14 is still included: Twitch 31.7 support, ad-blocking, 7TV / BTTV / FFZ emotes (send them with the 7TV bar or by holding the emote button), Keep Live Feed Playing, Hide Stories and your default launch screen.

Downloads
- "tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.15.ipa": the full app.
- "tv.twitch-31.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.15-noplugins.ipa": app extensions removed, so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.

Using the AltStore / SideStore / Feather source? You'll get this update automatically:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/master/apps.json
"""

Upstream asset: "tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
TwitchMods v0.1.13 — for Twitch iOS 30.7

New in v0.1.13
- Casting & AirPlay now work with ad-blocking on. Previously, having the ad-block proxy enabled could make casting to a Chromecast crash after a few seconds, or make AirPlay to an Apple TV show "offline." The mod now automatically steps aside while you're casting/AirPlaying, so the stream plays on the TV — and your phone goes right back to blocking ads the moment you stop. (The stream *on the TV* still shows ads — the TV fetches the video itself, so that can't be blocked — but your phone stays ad-free.)

Everything else (v0.1.12)
- Blocks ads (live + VOD pre-rolls, feed banners, sponsor spots, the "Go Ad-Free" Turbo button)
- Keep Live Feed Playing · 7TV/BTTV/FFZ chat emotes + Reload · settings backup/restore · Diagnostics · launch screen · hide Stories

Downloads
- "tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13.ipa" — full app.
- "tv.twitch-30.7-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.13-noplugins.ipa" — app extensions removed so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.

Install with AltStore / SideStore (drag in the IPA) or TrollStore (tap +, pick the IPA).

apps.name: YouTube
apps.subtitle: YouTube with YTKACE
apps.localizedDescription:
YTKACE is an open-source YouTube enhancement for iOS.

It adds video, audio and Shorts downloads, background playback, PiP, playback speed controls, SponsorBlock, interface customization, tab editing, a download library, and searchable settings.

Two IPA builds are published: an iOS 16-compatible build based on YouTube 21.33.6, and an iOS 17+ build based on the latest supported YouTube version.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream release: https://github.com/itzzace/ytkace/releases/tag/v1.1.4
Upstream asset: "YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_21.42.4.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
by @itzzace0

What's new:
• Updated to YouTube 21.42.4
• Added a SponsorBlock button to the player to whitelist channels, vote on segments and submit new ones
• Added Report AI Channels to report channels to AiSList from the ⋯ menu
• Added Clean Copied Links to remove tracking like si= from links you copy or share
• Added options to remove items from the ⋯ menu
• Added Tab Bar options for Liquid Glass: Default, YTKACE, YouTube or Off
• Added Keep Shorts in Home, Search and on Channels

Fixed:
• Remove Previous/Next not working in playlists
• Blank space left when fullscreen actions are hidden
• Remove Mixes missing some mixes

YouTube 21.42.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs:
• "YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_21.42.4.ipa" for iOS 17 and newer
• "YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa" for iOS 16
